```{r}


first_stage_test_bis_predicted <- first_stage_data_clean %>%
  mutate(Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
    predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_creneau_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_creneau_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         uneff_creneau_unavailability = sum(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_day_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_day_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         uneff_day_unavailability = sum(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)
```

```{r}
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),

           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         uneff_unavailability_trigger =
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau, uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(uneff_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         
         ) %>%
```

```{r}
price_data_predicted_pub <- price_data_predicted %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(
    auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before),
    reference_auction = if (any(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(auction_before[pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)

    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction

  ungroup()%>% 
group_by(electricity_delivery_date,

    unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
```

```{r}
prepare_price_data <- function(data, unavail_col) {
  data %>%
    distinct(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col)) %>%
    select(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, !!sym(unavail_col), price_diff,
           gen_tot, unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables,
           reference_auction, Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, 
           Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
           cluster_var) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = distance_auction, 
                names_prefix = "price_", 
                values_from = price_diff) %>%
    {
      price_cols <- grep("^price_", colnames(.), value = TRUE)
      price_cols_filtered <- price_cols[as.numeric(sub("price_", "", price_cols)) %in% -2:2]
      price_cols_sorted <- mixedsort(price_cols_filtered)
      non_price_cols <- setdiff(colnames(.), price_cols)
      .[, c(non_price_cols, price_cols_sorted)]
    }
}

# Apply function
price_data_predicted_wide_pub <- prepare_price_data(price_data_predicted_pub, "unavail_pub")
price_data_predicted_wide_unpub <- prepare_price_data(price_data_predicted_unpub, "unavail_unpub")
price_data_predicted_wide_uneff <- prepare_price_data(price_data_predicted_uneff, "unavail_uneff")



```



```{r}
group_and_summarize <- function(data, unavail_col) {
  data %>%
    arrange(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, !!sym(unavail_col)) %>%
    group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, gen_tot, unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables) %>%
    summarize(across(starts_with("price"), 
                     ~ ifelse(all(is.na(.)), NA, sum(., na.rm = TRUE))),
              creneau = first(creneau),
              reference_auction = first(reference_auction),
              !!sym(unavail_col) := max(abs(!!sym(unavail_col)), na.rm = TRUE),
              electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
              cluster_var = first(cluster_var),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(unavail_col)) & is.finite(!!sym(unavail_col)))# &!!sym(unavail_col) != 0)
}


# Apply the function to each dataset
price_data_predicted_grouped_pub <- group_and_summarize(price_data_predicted_wide_pub, "unavail_pub")
price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub <- group_and_summarize(price_data_predicted_wide_unpub, "unavail_unpub")
price_data_predicted_grouped_uneff <- group_and_summarize(price_data_predicted_wide_uneff, "unavail_uneff")

```




```{r}
var <- "unavail_uneff"
data <- price_data_predicted_grouped_uneff

price_cols <- grep("^price_", colnames(price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub), value = TRUE)
price_cols_filtered <- price_cols[as.numeric(sub("price_", "", price_cols)) %in% -2:2]
price_cols_sorted <- mixedsort(price_cols_filtered)


evaluate_price_coeff <- function(data, var){
  table_coefficients_predicted <- data.frame()
  col = "price_0"
  
  for (col in price_cols_sorted){
    # Créer la formule pour la régression
    
    # Créer la formule en utilisant backticks pour le nom de colonne
    formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ ", var ," + gen_tot +
                                intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction)+ as.factor(creneau)" , sep = ""))
    
    model <- lm(formula, data = data)

    vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cluster_var)
    # # Erreurs standard clusterisées
    cl_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

      # Fit model
    # Classic (non-clustered) standard errors
    classic_se <- summary(model)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

    # Coefficient name (assumes you're interested in the second regressor)
    coef_names <- names(coef(model))
    target_var <- coef_names[2]
    
    # Degrees of freedom
    n_ddl <- df.residual(model)
    
    # Create comparison row
    temp_df <- data.frame(
      variable = col,
      estimate = coef(model)[target_var],
      std_error_classic = classic_se[target_var],
      std_error_clustered = cl_se[target_var],
      t_value_classic = coef(model)[target_var] / classic_se[target_var],
      t_value_clustered = coef(model)[target_var] / cl_se[target_var],
      p_value_classic = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coef(model)[target_var] / classic_se[target_var]), df = n_ddl)),
      p_value_clustered = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coef(model)[target_var] / cl_se[target_var]), df = n_ddl))
    )


    # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
    table_coefficients_predicted <- rbind(table_coefficients_predicted, temp_df)
  }
return(table_coefficients_predicted)
}

table_coefficients_predicted_pub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_pub, "unavail_pub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Published")

table_coefficients_predicted_unpub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub, "unavail_unpub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Unpublished")

table_coefficients_predicted_uneff <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_uneff, "unavail_uneff") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Uneffective")



```



```{r}

table_coefficients_predicted <- rbind(table_coefficients_predicted_pub, table_coefficients_predicted_unpub, table_coefficients_predicted_uneff)

table_coefficients_predicted<- table_coefficients_predicted %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)))


# Ajouter un léger décalage sur l'axe X en fonction de 'status'
ggplot(data = table_coefficients_predicted, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
           y = estimate, 
           color = status)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage horizontal
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * std_error_clustered,
                    ymax = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * std_error_clustered), 
                width = 0.2, 
                alpha = 0.5, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage identique pour barres d'erreur
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to plant availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh Immobilisé")
```
